name: demo-script

# Demo script

- Use one versioned simulation world or algorithm fixture.
- Show startup input planning or perception behavior and measurable result.
- State simulator ROS 2 and environment assumptions.
- Include one failure boundary or safety limitation.
- Do not imply physical-world validation from simulation alone.
- Verify the workflow from a clean checkout before publishing.
